claim: A spectrum-matched sham of the S5 representation carries no state-tracking signal at L=40 (accuracy < 0.05).
limits: Measured 0.0747 at L=40; 0.0070 at L=160. Exploratory diagnosis: the relations the sham keeps (t^2=1, c^5=1) collapse words to reduced words, and 23% of test reduced words at L=40 had been seen in training, 0% at L=160. Kept as a refutation.
